_README: Hand-labelled ground truth for the 10 supplied resumes, produced by reading each document in full. Ten documents is small enough to label properly, which is the only reason the accuracy numbers in this project mean anything. `must_not_contain` encodes the specific attribution traps present in this corpus: values a careless parser reliably produces and which are wrong.

_conventions.years_experience: union of non-internship dated intervals, in years, evaluated as of the labelling date; compared with a +/-0.8y tolerance because roles marked 'present' drift with time
_conventions.employers: canonical employer names, order-insensitive; entities named inside a bullet but not employing the candidate are excluded and listed under must_not_contain
_conventions.null: means the document genuinely does not state this. The pipeline is expected to abstain or report missing, NOT to guess.

Chen Li (Alex).docx.notes: Employment overlap: Bank of China intern (Dec2019-May2021) runs concurrently with CUHK research assistant (Mar2019-Mar2021). Legitimate, but should be surfaced.

MARINA SILVA COSTA.docx.notes: ATTRIBUTION TRAP: a bullet under the Bain & Company heading reads 'Led launch of McKinsey's first case competition'. McKinsey is named inside the bullet but is not an employer. A parser that lifts company names out of bullet text will get this wrong.

Marcus Chen-Rodriguez Resume.docx.notes: Email 'rchen@hotmail' has no TLD and must be recorded verbatim, flagged as malformed, and NOT silently repaired to hotmail.com. Employment gap Mar2015->Apr2017. Portfolio companies where the candidate was a board observer are not employers.

institutions: University of Michigan, Ross School of Business
Michael Rodriguez, CFA.docx.notes: Contact details and the EDUCATION heading live in tables. Naive python-docx extraction appends tables after all paragraphs, which puts EDUCATION at the very end of the document and breaks section segmentation.

Omar El-Hassan 202405.pdf.notes: Two-column PDF; naive extraction interleaves the right-hand skills sidebar into the middle of the work-experience bullets. Type1 subsetting damage: U+019F reads as 'ti' and U+019E as 'tf', so raw text contains 'QuanTitaTive' and 'PorTfolio' variants. Full-time role 'Since May 2022' overlaps the stated internship Apr-Aug 2022 -- a real contradiction to surface.
